textTooWide: Text exceeds the label width. Enlarge the label or turn off human-readable text.
labelTooSmall: The barcode needs at least 2 dots per module. Enlarge the label, shorten the content or turn off text.
barcodeBounds: The barcode exceeds the label's safe area.
historyDamaged: History is damaged. Back up and move history.json out of the user data folder, then restart.
printPaused: Printing failed or is uncertain. Scanning is paused; check the device. Queued jobs continue without automatic retries.
blurPaused: The app lost focus. Start scanning again when you return.
historyStart: History is damaged. Scanning cannot start.
printerSave: Select an available printer and save the configuration.
workChanged: The work state changed. Start scanning again.
historyStopped: History is damaged. Printing is stopped to protect records. See the README for recovery steps.
historyMismatch: The stored label content is inconsistent.
historyLarge: The history file is too large.
debounceRange: The debounce window must be 100–60000 ms.
configFirst: Configure a print destination and save it.
configLarge: The configuration file is too large.
configMigrated: Old configuration migrated. Save to upgrade it to version 2.
configDamaged: Configuration is damaged or unsupported. Back up and reset it. The original file has not been overwritten.
configResetFirst: Back up and reset the damaged configuration first.
configSaved: Configuration saved. Click Start scanning to apply it.
configBackup: The original configuration was backed up.
configReset: The original configuration was backed up in the same folder. Configure and save again.
printerUnavailable: The selected printer is no longer available.
spoolTimeout: The print callback timed out. Check the system print queue.
prepareTimeout: Print preparation timed out. Nothing has been submitted.
workReady: Click Start scanning. Each complete scan will submit automatically.
foregroundOnly: Bring the app to the foreground before starting.
workActive: Listening for scans. Each complete scan ending in Enter is queued automatically.
workPaused: Scanning is paused. Queued jobs continue without automatic retries.
workRestart: Scanning is paused. Start again to resume.
frameSession: Invalid scan session or sequence number.
frameSequence: The scan sequence expired or is out of order. Pause and start again.
restartUncertain: The previous process stopped. The job may have been submitted. Check before explicitly reprinting.
restartQueued: The previous process stopped. Printing was not resumed automatically.
queueFull: The queue is full. Please wait.
jobPending: This job is still pending. Please wait.
historyWrite: History could not be saved. Nothing was sent.
submittedDetail: Only system/network submission is confirmed. Check the physical printout.
historyAfterSubmit: History could not be saved after submission. Check the printer. Restarting will not retry automatically.
aimConfig: The AIM configuration contains an unsupported identifier.
printNumbers: Invalid DPI, copy count or port.
ipOnly: Network printing requires an explicit IPv4 or IPv6 address.
charactersUnsupported: Control characters, GS1/FNC1, binary data and invalid Unicode are not supported.
aimUnsupported: Unknown, disabled or unsupported AIM identifier (GS1 is not supported).
dataMatrixAscii: Data Matrix supports ASCII only. Use QR Code for Unicode.
eanLength: EAN-13 requires exactly 13 digits including the check digit.
textAscii: Human-readable text supports ASCII only. Turn it off for non-ASCII content.
frameTimeout: The scan paused for over 1.5 seconds. The entire frame was discarded. Scan again.
frameIme: IME composition is not accepted in work mode. Use Manual test.
frameKey: The scan contains an unsupported key. Configure only an Enter suffix.
frameLong: The scan exceeds 1024 characters. The entire frame was rejected.
duplicateBlocked: A duplicate scan within {ms} ms was blocked. Use Explicit reprint in history if needed.
spoolRejected: The system did not confirm success: {reason}. Check the print queue.
languageDamaged: Language settings are damaged. Defaults are in use; saving your choice will back up the original file.
ready: Save your configuration, then click Start scanning.
shortcutScan: The scan contains a shortcut. The entire frame was rejected.
tabScan: The scan contains Tab. Configure an Enter suffix.
scanQueued: Scan added to the serial queue. Check the printout.
pasteScan: Work mode does not accept pasted content. Use Manual test.
imeScan: Disable IME composition and scan again.
testQueued: Test label queued. Check the printout.
testPreview: Enter test content to preview the label
workPreview: Your latest label appears here after scanning
previewHint: Preview uses the actual print bitmap. System submission does not confirm a physical printout.
setupHint: Settings stay on this device. This page pauses scanning; start again after saving.
oneCopyHint: One copy per scan is recommended. Check your printout with Manual test first.
waitingScanner: Waiting for scanner · Enter submits automatically
pausedHelp: Scanning is paused · click or press Alt+Enter to start; scanning itself will not start work
scannerSetup: Scanner setup: USB keyboard mode + Enter suffix
scannerHelp: Keep the app in the foreground. No input box needs focus. Leaving the app, configuration or dialogs pauses scanning. Start again when you return. Esc pauses.
testHint: Check content, labels and destinations without a scanner. Scanner intake is paused.
testPlaceholder: Example: 000123ABC; spaces and letter case are preserved
testEnterHint: Enter does not print here. Uses saved settings; GS1, binary data and control characters are rejected.
footer: Recreates barcode content and symbology, not the original label image. If printing fails or is uncertain, check the device before explicitly reprinting.
resetHint: The original file stays in the user data folder. Select your printer again after resetting. Print history is preserved.
aimHint: Symbology is never guessed. Without an AIM identifier, the selection above applies. GS1 / FNC1 is not supported.
tsplHint: TSPL uses continuous stock (GAP 0). Check the media settings.
debounceDuplicate: Block identical codes within a time window
duplicateHint: When repeats are allowed, each complete scan prints. Replaying the same frame always queues it only once.
historyHint: Keeps the latest 200 records on this device. Reprints use the record's label and printer settings.
reprintHint: Check the printer first to avoid duplicate output. This prints {count} copies again.
languageHint: Follow system: Chinese or English is matched; other languages use Chinese. Switching language never starts scanning.
languageFirst: Choose the interface language for this user. You can change it later in Configuration.
